node.statement: With Q:=J-P=(J-A)/2, the definitions 2P=J+A and 2Q=J-A give U+J=2P+(U-A) and U-J=-2Q+(U-A). Also ||U-A||=||U-U^dagger||/2<=C_fix*epsilon/2<=r/2. Hence r<=||U+J||<=2||P||+||U-A||<=2||P||+r/2 and r<=||U-J||<=2||Q||+||U-A||<=2||Q||+r/2. Subtracting r/2 and dividing by 2 yields ||P||>=r/4 and ||Q||>=r/4.
